author: KojaCola
body:
Hey Everyone,

Here is information for my second map...

  • Map Download - Coming Soon
  • Images of the map - https://imgur.com/a/260IO (With Texture Pack) Images without texture pack coming soon.
  • So this is my second map and I hope you enjoy! 
  • XML - Coming Soon
  • This is a DTM map, with emerald blocks as the objective. 
  • Orange vs. Green 15 vs. 15
  • Contributors: Cheetah2Furious and Prodigy
I hope you enjoy!

Koja.
